_schema.BuggyVersion: version or commit on which the reproducer shows the inconsistency
_schema.FixedVersion: version or commit on which it does not (or the fixing PR)
_schema.PythonEntry: reproducer file next to this manifest: defines `f` (or a torch.compile target) and `args`
_schema.SemanticFactor: shape | dtype | stride | device | requires_grad | scalar | flag | alias/mutation | compile_flag | backend
_schema.ExpectedBehavior: eager / reference behaviour in one sentence
_schema.ActualBehavior: compiled / JIT behaviour in one sentence
_schema.CompilerStage: dynamo_capture | aot_functionalization | inductor_codegen | triton_codegen | specialization_cache | cache_invalidation
_schema.Verified: true only after a person has run the reproducer on both versions

_selection_criteria: a fixed commit/version (or an explicit fix) is known
the defect is a consistency failure, not API misuse
_note: Entries are filled from the toxic-compilation dataset after manual verification (plan section 21). Nothing here is used as an empirical contribution; the file is a ground-truth detection benchmark. Run: python run.py bench --historical benchmark/historical_bugs.json
